import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 32;
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static int n;
    static Matrix E = new Matrix();
    static Matrix[] A = new Matrix[MAXN];
    static Matrix[] pre = new Matrix[MAXN];
    static Matrix[] suf = new Matrix[MAXN];
    static Matrix ans = new Matrix();

    static class Matrix {
        int[][] a = new int[MAXN][MAXN];

        void reset() {
            for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < MAXN; j++) {
                    a[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
        }

        void print() {
            for (int i = 1; i <= n + 1; i++) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= n + 1; j++) {
                    System.out.print(a[i][j] + (j == n ? "\n" : " "));
                }
            }
            System.out.println();
        }

        Matrix multiply(Matrix rhs) {
            Matrix res = new Matrix();
            res.reset();
            for (int i = 1; i <= n + 1; i++) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= n + 1; j++) {
                    for (int k = 1; k <= n + 1; k++) {
                        addMod(res.a[i][j], (long) a[i][k] * rhs.a[k][j] % MOD);
                    }
                }
            }
            return res;
        }
    }

    static void addMod(int x, int y) {
        x += y;
        if (x >= MOD) x -= MOD;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long m = sc.nextLong();
        n = sc.nextInt();

        E.reset();
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            E.a[i][i] = 1;
        }
        ans = E;

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            A[i] = new Matrix();
            A[i].reset();
            A[i].a[i][i] = 1;
        }

        pre[0] = new Matrix();
        pre[0].reset();
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            pre[i] = new Matrix();
            pre[i].reset();
            pre[i] = pre[i - 1].multiply(A[i]);
        }

        suf[n + 1] = new Matrix();
        suf[n + 1].reset();
        for (int i = n; i >= 1; i--) {
            suf[i] = new Matrix();
            suf[i].reset();
            suf[i] = A[i].multiply(suf[i + 1]);
        }

        while (m != 0) {
            long u = m % n;
            if (u != 0) {
                long s = 0, v = m / n;
                while (v != 0) {
                    s = (s + v % n) % n;
                    v /= n;
                }
                u = (s + u - 1) % n + 1;
                for (; u != s; u--) {
                    if (u <= 0) u += n;
                    ans = A[(int) u].multiply(ans);
                }
            }
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                pre[i] = pre[i - 1].multiply(A[i]);
            }
            for (int i = n; i >= 1; i--) {
                suf[i] = A[i].multiply(suf[i + 1]);
            }
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                A[i] = suf[i].multiply(pre[i - 1]);
            }
            m /= n;
        }

        int res = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            addMod(res, ans.a[n + 1][i]);
        }
        System.out.println(res);
        sc.close();
    }
}
